frame: u8 messageId followed by fields in declared order; one message per WebSocket binary frame. Decoders reject unknown ids, short frames and trailing bytes.

primitives.pos: i16 quantized metres, value = raw / posScale
primitives.pitch: i16 quantized radians, value = raw / 32767 * PI/2
primitives.bytes16: u16 byte length + raw bytes (opaque payload, e.g. a voice frame)

types.inputButtons: u8 bitmask: 1=fireHeld 2=reload 4=interact 8=revive 16=switchWeapon 32=firePressed (latched edge since last input) 64=aimDownSights (held)
types.entitySub: u8: zombieType index for zombies, held weapon index for players

coordinates: Sim plane is Godot (x, z); y is up. yaw=0 faces -Z, positive yaw turns left (Godot rotation.y). pitch>0 looks up.

indexTables.weapon: index into the sorted keys of weapons.json
indexTables.zombieType: index into the sorted keys of zombies.json
indexTables.box: index into the map's interactables of kind 'box', in file order
indexTables.entry: index into the map's zombieEntries, in file order

eventFields.hit: a=zombie id, b=player id, value=damage (rounded), flags bit0=head
eventFields.kill: a=zombie id, b=player id, value=zombieType index, flags bit0=head
eventFields.purchase: a=player id, b=weapon index (flags 0/1) or perk index (flags 3), value=cost, flags 0=weapon 1=ammo 2=box 3=perk
eventFields.boxOpened: a=player id, b=box index, value=roll time in 0.1 s
eventFields.boxOffer: a=player id, b=box index, value=weapon index
eventFields.boxTaken: a=player id, b=box index, value=weapon index
eventFields.playerDamaged: a=player id, b=source entity id, value=damage (rounded)
eventFields.zombieSpawned: a=zombie id, b=zombieType index, value=entry index
eventFields.powerupDropped: a=powerup entity id, b=powerupType index, value=lifetime in 0.1 s (position: snapshot entity of kind powerup)

snapshotFields.ackSeq: seq of the last input the server applied for this player (client prediction replays inputs after it)
snapshotFields.remaining: zombies left in the current wave
snapshotFields.timer: seconds until the next wave x10 (intermission only)

_dailyNote: Phase 23. C2S daily asks for the state, claimDaily takes today's streak reward. S2C daily is sent after welcome, on request, after a claim and after each recorded game; paidMicro/paidKind tell what that message just paid (missions are paid automatically when done, the all-missions bonus with them). nextDay = the streak day (1-7) today's claim pays, or paid if already claimed; resetSec = seconds to the next day (00:00 UTC).
_cardNote: Phase 25. C2S card {lang} asks for the result card of the game being played (or the last one recorded); S2C card answers with the status (cardStatus), the public URL of the JPEG the server drew from its own numbers, a small PNG preview (the web engine has no JPEG decoder), and the id of a prepared Telegram message (savePreparedInlineMessage) for WebApp.shareMessage, "" when there is none.
_reportNote: Phase 29. clientInfo (once after welcome) and perf (average FPS over a game, sent when it ends) describe the device for the owner's statistics only; nothing in them is trusted for play. A problem report is reportShot parts (an optional WebP screenshot, at most 12 parts) followed by report {category (reportCategory), where (menu / game / wave), fps, details: short JSON of the client's settings}; the server adds what it knows itself, sends it to the owners through the bot and answers reported {status (reportStatus), id}.
_puzzleNote: Phase 31. The puzzles are server logic the owner keeps secret (an encrypted module); the client only draws generic objects and sends what the player does. puzzleObjects is the zone's whole set (sent on join and whenever objects come or go), with labels in the player's language; puzzleState changes one object (state meaning by kind: text 0 hidden 1 shown; lantern 0 dark 1 lit 2 flash; terminal 0 off 1 on 2 locked; lever 0 down 1 up; cage 0 off 1 live; canister 0 resting, else the carrier's entity id; transmitter 0 dead 1 powered 2 sending; case 0 closed 1 open). puzzleUse asks to use an object (code for a keypad: codeLength digits). puzzleMsg is a line of text for everyone in the zone (big = a banner). Shots at objects are worked out by the server from its own shots.
_levelNote: Phase 26. welcome and profile carry the account's xp and level (computed by the server from shared constants.progression); roster entries carry each player's level so teammates see ranks.
_tonNote: tonMicro = TON points in millionths (1000 = 0.001 TON). Earned per kill in online zones only; the server owns every number. Prizes are paid by the owner by hand from the weekly leaderboard.
_voiceNote: Voice frames are opaque to the server: it relays each C2S voice frame to the other connected members of the zone that listen (voiceListen), stamped with the speaker's entityId. Format (client/web/voice.js): 40 ms of 16 kHz mono IMA ADPCM, 4-byte header + 320 bytes.
_infectionNote: Infection mode (gameMode 1): no AI zombies. Player entities on the infected team carry entityFlags.zombie; selfState.flags bit 4 marks the local player infected. snapshot.wave is the round, remaining the soldiers left, timer tenths of a second left in the lobby countdown, round or result pause. Events: playerKilled (a victim, b killer, flags 1 head), infected (a victim, b by), roundStart (a round, b infected count, value seconds), roundEnd (a round, flags 1 soldiers win).
